title: Janet zone inventory
summary: Weather, wind, shade and the loose parts available in one zone, recorded at the start of a round.
source: Variables to use for App testing.xlsx, Sheet1 rows 13–32 — see docs/Janet-Test-Form-Scope.md
inclusion: Climate (Sheet1 rows 13–17) and the loose-parts inventory by zone (rows 19–32), asked once per zone in an Inventory round. Excludes the eight hidden inventory rows (33–40). Option codes are provisional implementation identifiers and are not workbook values.

protocolNotes.title: Each quantity has a None option
protocolNotes.detail: The workbook's quantity bands start at Small (3 items or less) and its display rule reads 'if YES'. A None option records absence explicitly, and the list of items opens for any quantity except None. Confirm before research use.

protocolNotes.title: The inventory checklists are typed for now
protocolNotes.detail: The workbook asks for a checklist of common items with room for custom ones, but the common list has not been supplied. Observers type what is available, so no item list is invented from the examples.

protocolNotes.title: Climate is recorded with each zone
protocolNotes.detail: Weather, wind and shade are asked with each zone's inventory, as Janet asked on 2026-10-07. If climate should be recorded once per round instead, it moves to the round.

protocolNotes.title: Four hidden inventory groups stay excluded
protocolNotes.detail: Sand, mud and water toys, household items, sporting equipment and riding equipment (Sheet1 rows 33–40) are hidden in the workbook and stay out, as for the first test form.
